services.name: Big Island Waterfalls Adventure
services.desc: Swim in a Private Waterfall and Visit a Tropical Garden Duration 10-11 hours About Visit majestic Waipio Valley Lookout to capture lush and tall cliffs that drop into the sparkling ocean Walk through a rainforest and discover the towering Akaka Falls that plummets into a stream-eroded gorge Explore Hawaii Tropical Bioreserve & Garden, a spectacular nature preserve with cascading waterfalls Swim under the 120-feet tall Kulaniapia private waterfall surrounded by diverse flora Visit the famous 80-foot Rainbow Falls in Hilo with giant banyan trees beside it Traverse the scenic Saddle Road and marvel at the tallest and most massive mountains in the world Explore Hawaii Tropical Botanical Garden,

services.name: Twilight Volcano and Stargazing Tour
services.desc: In Depth Exploration of Volcanoes National Park Duration 12 Hours About Take a tour of a Kona Coffee Farm to learn about the harvesting and milling process while sampling Kona Coffee Visit must-see spots within Hawaii Volcanoes National Park including Kilauea Lookout and Thurston Lava Tube Taste delicious local treats at Punalu’u Bake Shop, the famous southernmost bakery in the USA Dip your toes in the sand at Punalu’u Black Sand Beach and scan the horizon for green sea turtles on the shore Observe stars and planets under the pristine night sky, weather permitting. See rare black sand beaches, walk through a lava tube, visit the famous Kona Coffee Farm and the magnificent Hawaii Volcanoes

services.name: Historical Kona and Farm Tour
services.desc: Learn the Fascinating History and Visit Local Farms Duration 7-8 Hours About Visit ancient royal grounds at the sacred site of Pu’uhonua o Honaunau National Historical Park Take a guided nature walk through Kaloko-Honokohau National Historical Park to see ancient fishponds and seawalls Honey tasting & beekeeper-led talk at Big Island Bees and sip coffee on a tour of a coffee plantation Delve into the fascinating history and vibrant culture of the Big Island of Hawaii. Tour ancient Hawaiian sites along the coast, visit early churches and Kealakekua Bay, and make stops at a honey farm and coffee orchard to taste some of the island’s locally made treats.
